name: Rehearsal S3: flap-actuator pin-jointed link, three load cases (invented card, not an official task)
source: invented 2026-11-03 for docs/12 S3; all numbers invented for the rehearsal

geometry._note: tension, compression and a 30 % side load at the right pin; the left pin is fixed. Buckling of the compression case is NOT checked by the plane-stress model: check the slender member by hand

loads._note: actuator limit load (invented); ultimate = 1.5 x 1.15 x limit

limits._note: 1.0 mm worst-case displacement of the loaded pin along its load (invented). The 30 % side load governs it: the link then bends like a cantilever from the fixed pin
